description: HR-Portal - a Polish HR management application (Users & flexible Roles, Companies, Employees, an occupational exposure factors catalogue, and standardized medical examination referrals with PDF generation), built with a Symfony 6 + API Platform backend (PHP 8.5, thick services / thin controllers) and a React + Tailwind CSS frontend, all running via Docker Compose.

userStories.title: Docker Compose environment
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Docker Compose stack so the whole app (frontend, backend, database, dev tooling) runs locally with one command.
acceptanceCriteria: docker-compose.yml defines services: php (PHP 8.5-FPM running Symfony 6), nginx, postgres (PostgreSQL 16), and node (Vite dev server)
`docker compose up` starts all services without errors
Nginx serves the Symfony app on a documented port (e.g. http://localhost:8000)
.env.example documents DB credentials, JWT key paths, CORS origin, and app URL
README documents how to start the stack, run migrations, and load fixtures
`docker compose config` validates the compose file without errors

userStories.title: Symfony 6 + API Platform skeleton
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Symfony 6 project with API Platform installed and configured so backend resources can be exposed as a REST API.
acceptanceCriteria: Symfony 6.4 project scaffolded under backend/, running on PHP 8.5 inside the php container
api-platform/core installed and configured (JSON as default format); /api/docs returns API documentation
nelmio/cors-bundle configured to allow requests from the frontend dev origin
Doctrine ORM configured against the postgres service; `bin/console doctrine:database:create` succeeds
GET /api/health returns 200 OK
`composer install` completes without errors inside the php container

userStories.title: React + Tailwind skeleton
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a React app with Tailwind and routing set up so feature panels can be built consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: React app scaffolded under frontend/ using Vite + TypeScript
Tailwind CSS configured; a sample page renders Tailwind-styled content
React Router configured with placeholder routes: /login, /dashboard, /users, /companies, /employees, /exposure-factors, /referrals
Shared layout component (sidebar nav + top bar) renders around the authenticated routes
Typecheck passes (`tsc --noEmit`)
Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill: app loads at the dev server URL and navigation links switch routes

userStories.title: User and Role entities + migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need User and Role entities with a many-to-many relationship so roles can be assigned flexibly and new roles added later without code changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Role entity: id, code (unique string, e.g. ROLE_ADMIN), name (Polish display name), description (nullable text)
User entity implements UserInterface/PasswordAuthenticatedUserInterface: id, email (unique), password, firstName, lastName, isActive (default true), createdAt
Many-to-many join table user_role between User and Role
User::getRoles() returns the code of each assigned Role plus ROLE_USER as a base role for every user
Doctrine migration generated and runs successfully (`bin/console doctrine:migrations:migrate`)
Backend code passes lint (`php bin/console lint:container` and `php -l` on changed files)

userStories.title: Seed data for Roles and default Admin user
userStories.description: As a developer, I need fixtures so the app has a working Admin account and base roles after first setup.
acceptanceCriteria: doctrine/doctrine-fixtures-bundle installed
Fixture creates Role records: ROLE_ADMIN ("Administrator") and ROLE_USER ("Użytkownik")
Fixture creates one Admin user (email/password documented in README, e.g. admin@hr-portal.local) assigned ROLE_ADMIN, with a properly hashed password
`bin/console doctrine:fixtures:load` runs without error
Tests pass (PHPUnit test confirms the admin user exists with ROLE_ADMIN after loading fixtures)

userStories.title: JWT authentication
userStories.description: As a user, I want to log in with email/password and receive a JWT so I can make authenticated API requests.
acceptanceCriteria: lexik/jwt-authentication-bundle installed and configured with a generated key pair
POST /api/login accepts { email, password } and returns a JWT (payload includes user id, email, roles) on success, 401 on invalid credentials
Custom UserChecker rejects login for users with isActive = false, returning a clear error
All other /api/* routes (except /api/login and /api/docs) require a valid JWT (401 if missing/invalid)
Token TTL is configurable via .env (default 1 hour)
Tests pass (PHPUnit functional tests cover valid login, invalid credentials, and inactive user)

userStories.title: Authorization voter for admin-only resources
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Security Voter restricting User and Role management to admins so future roles can be granted/denied access without rewriting controllers.
acceptanceCriteria: A UserManagementVoter (or equivalent) grants access to /api/users and /api/roles operations only to subjects with ROLE_ADMIN
Voter is registered as a service and applied via #[IsGranted] attributes or security access_control rules, not inline controller checks
All other resources remain accessible to any authenticated user (IS_AUTHENTICATED_FULLY)
Tests pass (PHPUnit test: a non-admin user gets 403 from /api/users and /api/roles; an admin user gets 200)

userStories.title: Login page (frontend)
userStories.description: As a user, I want a login form so I can access the portal.
acceptanceCriteria: /login page with email + password fields and a submit button
On success, the JWT is stored and the user is redirected to /dashboard
On failure, an inline Polish error message is shown ("Nieprawidłowy e-mail lub hasło")
A centralized API client attaches `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to all requests and redirects to /login on 401
Unauthenticated users visiting any protected route are redirected to /login
A "Wyloguj" action clears the token and redirects to /login
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill: log in with the seeded admin credentials and reach the dashboard

userStories.title: User CRUD API (admin only)
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want API endpoints to list, create, update, and remove Users, with their Roles, so I can manage portal access.
acceptanceCriteria: API Platform resource for User exposes GET /api/users (list), GET /api/users/{id}, POST /api/users, PATCH /api/users/{id}, DELETE /api/users/{id}, restricted to ROLE_ADMIN via the US-007 voter

POST /api/users accepts email, password, firstName, lastName, roles (array of Role codes); password is hashed via a custom API Platform state processor that delegates to a UserService (not the controller)
PATCH /api/users/{id} allows updating firstName, lastName, isActive, and roles
An Admin cannot delete or deactivate their own account; UserService rejects this with a 409/422 and a Polish error message
Output serialization excludes the password field
Tests pass (PHPUnit covers user creation with roles, password hashing, and self-deletion rejection)

userStories.title: Role API (admin only)
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want API endpoints to list and create Roles so new roles can be introduced without code changes.
acceptanceCriteria: API Platform resource for Role exposes GET /api/roles (list) and POST /api/roles (code, name, description), restricted to ROLE_ADMIN via the US-007 voter
POST /api/roles validates that `code` is unique and matches a ROLE_* pattern, returning 422 with field errors on violation
No delete operation is exposed for Role, or if exposed, RoleService rejects deletion of the seeded ROLE_ADMIN role
Tests pass (PHPUnit covers creating a new role and rejecting a duplicate/invalid code)

userStories.title: User management panel (frontend)
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want a panel to view all users, add new ones, remove them, and manage their roles.
acceptanceCriteria: /users page (nav item visible only for ROLE_ADMIN users) lists users with email, name, roles, and active status
"Add user" form/modal creates a user with email, password, first/last name, and a multi-select of roles populated from /api/roles
Each row has a "Remove"/"Deactivate" action with a confirmation dialog before submitting
Each row allows editing assigned roles via the multi-select, saved via PATCH /api/users/{id}
Non-admin users navigating to /users directly are redirected to /dashboard
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill: as admin, create a new user, assign a role, then remove the user

userStories.title: Company entity + API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Company entity and API so employees can later be linked to a company.
acceptanceCriteria: Company entity: id, name, nip (string, validated as a 10-digit Polish NIP), street, city, postalCode, createdAt
API Platform resource exposes GET /api/companies, GET /api/companies/{id}, POST /api/companies, PATCH /api/companies/{id}, DELETE /api/companies/{id} for any authenticated user
Validation constraints enforce required fields and NIP format, returning 422 with field-level errors on failure
Business logic (validation orchestration) lives in a CompanyService, not the controller
Tests pass (PHPUnit covers create, NIP validation failure, and delete)

userStories.title: Company management panel (frontend)
userStories.description: As a user, I want a panel to add, view, and remove Companies.
acceptanceCriteria: /companies page lists companies with name, NIP, and address
"Add company" form creates a company with name, NIP, street, city, postal code; client-side validation mirrors backend constraints
"Remove" action shows a confirmation dialog before calling DELETE /api/companies/{id}
Form and list show validation/error messages in Polish
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill: add a company, see it in the list, then remove it

userStories.title: Employee entity + API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an Employee entity and API so employee records can be managed and linked to a Company.
acceptanceCriteria: Employee entity: id, firstName, lastName, pesel (string, validated as 11-digit Polish PESEL), phone, email, address (free text), company (ManyToOne to Company, required), createdBy (ManyToOne to User), createdAt
API Platform resource exposes GET /api/employees (paginated), GET /api/employees/{id}, POST /api/employees, PATCH /api/employees/{id}, DELETE /api/employees/{id} for any authenticated user
POST/PATCH validate PESEL (11 digits) and email format, returning 422 with field errors on failure
createdBy is set automatically from the authenticated user via a state processor, not accepted from client input
POST /api/employees requires a valid `company` IRI; returns 422 if missing or referencing a non-existent company
API Platform SearchFilter enabled on firstName, lastName, and company
CompanyService::delete is updated to return 409 with a Polish error message when the company has linked Employees
Tests pass (PHPUnit covers employee creation with company link, PESEL validation, and the company-delete-with-employees 409 case)

userStories.title: Employee management panel (frontend)
userStories.description: As a user, I want a panel to add, view, and remove Employees, assigning each to a Company.
acceptanceCriteria: /employees page lists employees with name, phone, email, address, and company name; supports search by name and filter by company
"Add employee" form includes Imię, Nazwisko, PESEL, Telefon, E-mail, Adres, and a Company dropdown populated from /api/companies
Client-side validation for PESEL (11 digits) and email format, mirroring backend errors, shown in Polish
"Remove" action shows a confirmation dialog before calling DELETE /api/employees/{id}
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill: add an employee linked to an existing company, see it in the list, then remove it

userStories.title: ExposureCategory and ExposureFactor entities + migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need entities for the 5 fixed exposure-factor categories and their factors so the catalogue can be stored and managed.
acceptanceCriteria: ExposureCategory entity: id, code (e.g. I-V), name (Polish display name), sortOrder
ExposureFactor entity: id, name, category (ManyToOne to ExposureCategory), description (nullable)
Doctrine migration generated and runs successfully
Backend code passes lint (`php bin/console lint:container` and `php -l` on changed files)

userStories.title: Exposure factor fixtures (5 categories + seed factors)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need fixtures seeding the 5 fixed categories from the official Polish medical referral form, each with real example factors, so users have a working catalogue out of the box.
acceptanceCriteria: Fixtures seed exactly 5 ExposureCategory records matching Annex 3 of Rozporządzenie Ministra Zdrowia i Opieki Społecznej z dnia 30 maja 1996 r.: I. Czynniki fizyczne, II. Pyły, III. Czynniki chemiczne, IV. Czynniki biologiczne, V. Inne czynniki, w tym niebezpieczne

I. Czynniki fizyczne seeded with at least: Hałas; Hałas ultradźwiękowy; Wibracja (drgania mechaniczne) ogólne; Wibracja (drgania mechaniczne) miejscowe; Mikroklimat gorący; Mikroklimat zimny; Promieniowanie optyczne (UV/IR/widzialne); Promieniowanie laserowe; Promieniowanie jonizujące; Pole elektromagnetyczne; Praca przy monitorach ekranowych powyżej 4 godzin dziennie

II. Pyły seeded with at least: Pyły zawierające azbest; Pyły zawierające wolną krzemionkę; Pyły drewna; Pyły rud metali; Pyły węgla; Pyły mączne; Pyły bawełny; Pyły zwierzęce i roślinne niesklasyfikowane

III. Czynniki chemiczne seeded with at least: Substancje o działaniu toksycznym; Substancje o działaniu drażniącym; Substancje o działaniu uczulającym (alergizującym); Substancje o działaniu rakotwórczym lub mutagennym; Substancje o działaniu szkodliwym na rozrodczość; Rozpuszczalniki organiczne; Metale i ich związki (ołów, rtęć, kadm, chrom, nikiel); Pestycydy; Tlenek węgla; Tlenki azotu

IV. Czynniki biologiczne seeded with at least: Wirusy; Bakterie; Grzyby (pleśnie); Pasożyty; Materiał biologiczny pochodzenia ludzkiego (krew, płyny ustrojowe); Mikroorganizmy w środowisku pracy rolniczej/leśnej; Kontakt ze zwierzętami

V. Inne czynniki, w tym niebezpieczne seeded with at least: Praca na wysokości; Obsługa maszyn i urządzeń w ruchu; Wymuszona pozycja ciała; Obciążenie statyczne układu mięśniowo-szkieletowego; Obciążenie dynamiczne (praca fizyczna ciężka); Praca w porze nocnej; Praca zmianowa; Obciążenie psychiczne związane z odpowiedzialnością/kontaktem z ludźmi; Praca przy urządzeniach pod napięciem; Praca w warunkach ograniczonej widoczności; Ryzyko poślizgnięcia, potknięcia, upadku
`bin/console doctrine:fixtures:load` runs without error and produces exactly 5 categories with the factors above
Tests pass (PHPUnit test asserts 5 categories exist with the expected codes after loading fixtures)

userStories.title: Exposure factor API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an API to list categories with their factors (read-only) and to add/remove factors within them.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/exposure-categories returns all 5 categories with their factors (nested or via subresource), for any authenticated user, in sortOrder
ExposureCategory is read-only via the API (no POST/PATCH/DELETE operations exposed)
GET /api/exposure-factors, POST /api/exposure-factors, DELETE /api/exposure-factors/{id} available to any authenticated user; POST requires name and a valid category IRI

DELETE /api/exposure-factors/{id} returns 409 with a Polish error message if the factor is referenced by any ReferralExposureFactor (logic in ExposureFactorService) — implementable now with a guard that currently always allows deletion until US-020 introduces the referencing entity, then re-checked in US-021
Tests pass (PHPUnit covers listing categories with factors, adding a factor, and removing a factor)

userStories.title: Czynniki narażeń panel (frontend)
userStories.description: As a user, I want a panel showing the 5 fixed categories with their factors, where I can add new factors and remove existing ones.
acceptanceCriteria: /exposure-factors page renders the 5 categories (in I-V order) as sections/cards, each listing its factors
Each category section has an "Add factor" inline form (name + optional description) posting to /api/exposure-factors with the correct category
Each factor row has a "Remove" action with confirmation; shows a Polish error message if the API returns 409 (factor in use)
Category names/headers are not editable or removable in the UI
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill: all 5 categories render with seeded factors, add a new factor to a category, then remove it

userStories.title: Referral and ReferralExposureFactor entities + migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Referral entity capturing all fields from the official Polish referral form, linked to selected exposure factors with per-factor exposure details.
acceptanceCriteria: Referral entity: id, employee (ManyToOne, required), examinationType (PHP enum: wstepne | okresowe | kontrolne), jobPosition, jobDescription (text), issuePlace, issueDate, createdBy (ManyToOne to User), pdfPath (nullable string), pdfGeneratedAt (nullable datetime), createdAt
ReferralExposureFactor join entity: id, referral (ManyToOne), factor (ManyToOne to ExposureFactor), exposureDetails (text)
Doctrine migration generated and runs successfully
ExposureFactorService::delete (US-018) now checks ReferralExposureFactor references and returns 409 if the factor is in use
Backend code passes lint (`php bin/console lint:container` and `php -l` on changed files)

userStories.title: Referral API (create, list, delete)
userStories.description: As a user, I want API endpoints to create a Referral for an Employee with selected exposure factors, and to list/delete referrals.
acceptanceCriteria: API Platform resource for Referral exposes GET /api/referrals (paginated, ordered by issueDate desc), GET /api/referrals/{id}, POST /api/referrals, DELETE /api/referrals/{id} for any authenticated user

POST /api/referrals accepts employee IRI, examinationType, jobPosition, jobDescription, issuePlace, issueDate, and an array of { factor: IRI, exposureDetails: string }; creates the Referral and its ReferralExposureFactor rows in one transaction via a ReferralService (not the controller)
createdBy is set automatically from the authenticated user via a state processor
Validation: examinationType must be one of the 3 enum values; employee must reference an existing Employee; returns 422 with field errors otherwise
Tests pass (PHPUnit covers creating a referral with multiple factors across categories, validation failure for invalid examinationType, and deletion)

userStories.title: Referral creation form (frontend)
userStories.description: As a user, I want a form at the top of the Referrals panel to create a new referral for an employee, matching the official Polish form fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Form fields: Pracownik (employee select/search from /api/employees), Typ badania (wstępne / okresowe / kontrolne), Stanowisko pracy, Opis warunków pracy / zakres czynności (textarea), Miejsce wystawienia, Data wystawienia (date picker defaulting to today)
Form renders the 5 exposure categories (from /api/exposure-categories) each with checkboxes for its factors; checking a factor reveals a text input for "Wielkość narażenia / wyniki pomiarów"
Submitting calls POST /api/referrals with the selected employee, form fields, and the list of checked factors with their exposure details
On success, the new referral appears at the top of the list (placeholder list is acceptable if US-025 is not yet built) and the form resets
Required-field validation prevents submission with missing employee, examination type, or job position; errors shown in Polish
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill: fill the form for a seeded employee, select factors from at least 2 categories, submit, and confirm a success response

userStories.title: PDF generation service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service that renders a Referral as a PDF matching the official "Skierowanie na badania lekarskie" layout and stores it on the server filesystem.
acceptanceCriteria: dompdf/dompdf installed; a Twig template (referral_pdf.html.twig) reproduces the official form layout: employer designation + place/date header, "SKIEROWANIE NA BADANIA LEKARSKIE (wstępne/okresowe/kontrolne)" title with the selected type indicated, employee name + PESEL + address, job position and description, sections "I. Czynniki fizyczne" through "V. Inne czynniki, w tym niebezpieczne" each listing the selected factors with their exposure details, total count of factors, and a signature line
ReferralPdfGeneratorService::generate(Referral $referral): string renders the template and writes the PDF to a configurable storage path (e.g. var/referrals/{id}.pdf), returning the relative path
Regenerating overwrites the existing file
Tests pass (PHPUnit test generates a PDF for a sample referral with factors from multiple categories and asserts the file exists and is non-empty)

userStories.title: Referral PDF generate and download endpoints
userStories.description: As a user, I want API endpoints to trigger PDF generation for a referral and to download the resulting file.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/referrals/{id}/generate-pdf (custom API Platform operation or controller delegating entirely to ReferralPdfGeneratorService) generates the PDF, sets pdfPath and pdfGeneratedAt on the Referral, and returns the updated resource
Regenerating updates pdfGeneratedAt and overwrites the stored file
GET /api/referrals/{id}/pdf streams the stored PDF file for an authenticated user, returning 404 if no PDF has been generated yet
Tests pass (PHPUnit covers generate-pdf updating pdfPath/pdfGeneratedAt, and downloading the generated file)

userStories.title: Referral list with PDF download (frontend)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see all referrals in a list and generate/download a PDF for any of them.
acceptanceCriteria: /referrals page shows the creation form (US-022) at the top and a table below listing: Pracownik, Typ badania, Stanowisko, Data wystawienia, Status PDF (Wygenerowano / Nie wygenerowano)
Each row has a "Generuj PDF" button calling POST /api/referrals/{id}/generate-pdf; on success the button changes to/reveals a "Pobierz PDF" link
"Pobierz PDF" downloads the file via GET /api/referrals/{id}/pdf with the auth token attached
List is paginated matching the API Platform default page size
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill: from a referral created via the form, click "Generuj PDF", then download the resulting PDF and confirm a file is retrieved

userStories.title: App shell, navigation, and route guards
userStories.description: As a user, I want a consistent layout with navigation to all panels, showing only the sections my role allows.
acceptanceCriteria: Sidebar links: Dashboard, Użytkownicy (admin only), Firmy, Pracownicy, Czynniki narażeń, Skierowania
"Użytkownicy" link only renders for users whose roles include ROLE_ADMIN
Top bar shows the logged-in user's name/email and a "Wyloguj" button
All panel routes are wrapped in an authentication guard redirecting to /login if no valid token is present
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill: log in as a non-admin user (create one via the admin panel) and confirm "Użytkownicy" is not visible/accessible

userStories.title: Dashboard landing page
userStories.description: As a user, I want a simple dashboard after login summarizing key counts.
acceptanceCriteria: /dashboard shows counts: total Companies, total Employees, total Referrals
Counts are fetched from existing list endpoints using API Platform's totalItems from collection responses — no new backend endpoint required
Page renders within 1 second on local dev data volumes (seed data only)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using the playwright-cli skill: dashboard loads after login and shows non-zero counts after seed data is loaded
